sentences.en: (Music) [music by Moby]
sentences.zh: 音乐

sentences.en: [Grand Canyon] Narrator: Many of the tests are conducted
sentences.zh: 大峡谷（图像）解说：在伊夫斯带上飞行翼的时候，要做很多检测，

sentences.en: while Yves is strapped onto the wing, because Yves' body is an integral part of the aircraft.
sentences.zh: 要做很多检测，因为伊夫斯的身体是飞行器的一个部分。字幕：风洞检测

sentences.en: [Wind tunnel tests] Narrator: The wing has no steering controls, no flaps, no rudder.
sentences.zh: 字幕：风洞检测解说：翅膀没有方向控制器，没有折翼，没有方向舵。

sentences.en: Yves uses his body to steer the wing. Stefan Von Bergen: Well, he turns by just putting his head on one or the other side.
sentences.zh: 伊夫斯用身体操控翅膀。斯蒂芬 凡 卑尔根： 噢， 他就是靠把头转向一边或另一边来转向。有时他用手帮忙转向

sentences.en: And sometimes he assists that with his hands, sometimes even with the leg.
sentences.zh: 有时他用手帮忙转向有时甚至靠腿帮忙。可以说他就是一个人体飞机。

sentences.en: He's acting as a human fuselage, so to say.
sentences.zh: 可以说他就是一个人体飞机。这就是特别之处。

sentences.en: And that's quite unique. Narrator: When he arches his back, he gains altitude.
sentences.zh: 这就是特别之处。解说：他弓背的时候，就往上升。

sentences.en: When he pushes his shoulders forward, he goes into a dive.
sentences.zh: 而当他向前伸展肩膀就往下滑。

sentences.en: [Swiss Alps] [Strait of Gibraltar crossing]
sentences.zh: 字幕：阿尔卑斯山穿越直布罗陀海峡。

sentences.en: [English Channel crossing] Commentator One: There he goes.
sentences.zh: 穿越英吉利海峡评论：他来了伊夫斯 罗西来了！

sentences.en: There is Yves Rossy. And I think the wing is open.
sentences.zh: 伊夫斯 罗西来了！我想翅膀开了，翅膀开了

sentences.en: So our first critical moment, it's open.
sentences.zh: 这是第一个关键时刻，它开了。

sentences.en: He is down. Is he flying? Commentator Two: It looks like he's stabilized.
sentences.zh: 他下降了，他在飞吗？第二位评论： 看来他在保持速度他又开始上升。

sentences.en: He's starting to make his climb. Commentator One: There's that 90 degree turn.
sentences.zh: 他又开始上升。评论：他转身90度，就是你讲的那个。他已经到峡谷了。

sentences.en: He's out over the channel. There is Yves Rossy.
sentences.zh: 他已经到峡谷了。罗西来了。现在已不能回头。

sentences.en: There is no turning back now. He is over the English Channel and under way.
sentences.zh: 现在已不能回头。他穿过英吉利海峡和海底通道女士们，先生们，

sentences.en: Ladies and gentlemen, a historic flight has begun.
sentences.zh: 女士们，先生们，历史性的飞行时刻开始了

sentences.en: [Images: National Geographic] Commentator Two: And as he approaches the ground,
sentences.zh: 第二位评论员：他在往地面降落时会把那些栓扣拉下滑行。

sentences.en: he's going to pull down on those toggles to flare, slow himself down just a little bit, and then come in for a nice landing.
sentences.zh: 会把那些栓扣拉下滑行。放慢速度然后漂亮的降落。

sentences.en: Commentator One: There he is. Yves Rossy has landed in England.
sentences.zh: 评论：是他罗西在英格兰降落了。

sentences.en: Bruno Giussani: And now he's in Edinburgh. Yves Rossy!
sentences.zh: 布鲁诺 吉桑尼： 他现在在爱丁堡。 伊夫斯 罗西。（掌声）

sentences.en: (Applause) (Applause ends) And his equipment as well.
sentences.zh: （掌声）他把器材也拿来了。伊夫斯，欢迎。真棒。

sentences.en: Yves, welcome. It is quite amazing. Those sequences were shot over the last three years in various moments of your activities.
sentences.zh: 伊夫斯，欢迎。真棒。那些画面是三年前在你各种飞行活动中拍摄的还有许多许多其它的时刻。

sentences.en: And there were many, many others. So it's possible to fly almost like a bird.
sentences.zh: 还有许多许多其它的时刻。所以像鸟那样飞行还是可能的。在空中是什么感觉呢？

sentences.en: What is it like to be up there? Yves Rossy: It's fun. It's fun.
sentences.zh: 在空中是什么感觉呢？罗西: 很好玩。很好玩。（笑声）

sentences.en: (Laughter) I don't have feathers. But I feel like a bird sometimes.
sentences.zh: （笑声）我没有羽毛但我有时觉得自己像一只鸟。是一种不真实的感觉

sentences.en: It's really an unreal feeling, because normally you have a big thing, a plane, around you.
sentences.zh: 是一种不真实的感觉因为一般会有大的飞机在身边

sentences.en: And when I strap just this little harness, this little wing, I really have the feeling of being a bird.
sentences.zh: 当我带上这些小的降落伞被带，这个翅膀我真的觉得像一只鸟BG： 你怎么会开始当飞人的？

sentences.en: BG: How did you start to become Jetman? YR: It was about 20 years ago, when I discovered free falling.
sentences.zh: BG： 你怎么会开始当飞人的？YR： 那是20年前我发现了自由降落当我从飞机出去

sentences.en: When you go out of an airplane, you are almost naked.
sentences.zh: 当我从飞机出去几乎裸体就是那种动作

sentences.en: You take a position like that. And especially when you take a tracking position, you have the feeling that you are flying.
sentences.zh: 就是那种动作特别是采取跟随姿势时就有一种飞翔的感觉

sentences.en: And that's the nearest thing to the dream.
sentences.zh: 这就是最接近梦想的事了周围没有机器

sentences.en: You have no machine around you. You are just in the element.
sentences.zh: 周围没有机器只有我自己

sentences.en: It's very short and only in one direction.
sentences.zh: 航程很短，而且单项

sentences.en: (Laughter) So the idea was, okay, keep that feeling of freedom, but change the vector and increase the time.
sentences.zh: 所以主要思想就是，好的，保持那种自由的感觉但要改变航道，增加飞翔时间BG： 所以我有些好奇，你的最高速度是什么？

sentences.en: BG: So I'm kind of curious, what's your top speed?
sentences.zh: BG： 所以我有些好奇，你的最高速度是什么？YR： 转弯前大概每小时300 公里

sentences.en: YR: It's about 300 km per hour before looping.
sentences.zh: YR： 转弯前大概每小时300 公里

sentences.en: That means about 190 miles per hour. BG: What's the weight of the equipment you're carrying?
sentences.zh: 就是每小时190公里BG：那么你带的器械有多重呢？如果满载柴油

sentences.en: YR: When I exit full of kerosene, I'm about 55 kilos.
sentences.zh: 如果满载柴油我大概是55 公斤。我是说有55公斤在我的背上

sentences.en: I have 55 kilos on my back. BG: And you're not piloting?
sentences.zh: 我是说有55公斤在我的背上BG： 那你不飞的时候呢？没有拉手，没有方向盘，什么都没有吗？

sentences.en: There is no handle, no steering, nothing?
sentences.zh: 没有拉手，没有方向盘，什么都没有吗？就靠你的身体，

sentences.en: It is purely your body, and the wings become part of the body and vice versa?
sentences.zh: 就靠你的身体，翅膀变成你身体的部分，或者相反？YR：这真的是我的目标

sentences.en: YR: That's really the goal, because if you put in steering, then you reinvent the airplane.
sentences.zh: YR：这真的是我的目标因为如果我装上方向盘就等于重新发明飞机了，我想要的是保持这种自由的飞翔动作

sentences.en: And I wanted to keep this freedom of movement.
sentences.zh: 我想要的是保持这种自由的飞翔动作这很像孩子玩飞机

sentences.en: And it's really like the kid playing the airplane.
sentences.zh: 这很像孩子玩飞机我就想像那样下降

sentences.en: I want to go down like that. And up I climb, I turn.
sentences.zh: 我就想像那样下降然后上升，转弯。纯粹的飞行。

sentences.en: It's really pure flying. It's not steering, it's flight.
sentences.zh: 纯粹的飞行。不是航行，是飞行。BG： 你为此做了什么

sentences.en: BG: What kind of training do you do, you personally, for that?
sentences.zh: BG： 你为此做了什么个人训练吗？

sentences.en: YR: Actually, I try to stay just fit. I don't do special physical training.
sentences.zh: YR： 实际上，我努力保持健康我不做特别的体能训练我只是通过新的活动

sentences.en: I just try to keep my mobility through new activities.
sentences.zh: 我只是通过新的活动保持灵活比如

sentences.en: For example, last winter I began with kite surfing.
sentences.zh: 比如去年冬天，我开始风筝冲浪--做新的事情

sentences.en: So, new things. So you have to adapt. I'm quite an experienced manager of systems as a pilot, but this is, really -- You need fluidity,
sentences.zh: 做新的事情所以你必须适应所以就是--我是飞行员对于系统管理很有经验但是真是情况是我需要流畅性需要灵活

sentences.en: you need to be agile and also to adapt really fast.
sentences.zh: 需要灵活同时也要能适应快速BG： 有观众问

sentences.en: BG: Somebody in the audience asked me, "How does he breathe up there?"
sentences.zh: BG： 有观众问他在空中是怎么呼吸的？

sentences.en: Because you're going fast and you're up at 3,000 meters or so.
sentences.zh: 因为你的速度很快，而且你飞到高空3000米左右处

sentences.en: YR: Okay, up to 3,000 meters, it's not such a big problem with oxygen.
sentences.zh: YR： 是的，到3000米氧气不是大问题但是，举例说，自行车手

sentences.en: But for example, bikers, they have the same speed.
sentences.zh: 但是，举例说，自行车手也有同样的速度只要带上面罩

sentences.en: Just with the helmet, integral helmet, it's really no problem to breathe.
sentences.zh: 只要带上面罩呼吸不成问题给我谈谈你带来的这些器械。

sentences.en: BG: Describe for me the equipment, since you have it here.
sentences.zh: 给我谈谈你带来的这些器械。百年灵的四个引擎。

sentences.en: So Breitling's four engines. YR: Yeah, two-meter span.
sentences.zh: 百年灵的四个引擎。YR： 是的，两米长。

sentences.en: Ultra-stable profile. Four little engines, 22 kilos thrust each, turbines, working with kerosene.
sentences.zh: 超稳定系统。四个小的引擎每个22公里的推力，柴油涡轮机降落伞背带，降落伞

sentences.en: Harness, parachute. My only instruments are an altimeter and time.
sentences.zh: 降落伞背带，降落伞我唯一的仪器是测高仪和计时器。我知道我有大约8分钟的油可用

sentences.en: I know I have about eight minutes fuel. So I just check before it's finished.
sentences.zh: 我知道我有大约8分钟的油可用所以在用完前要检查一下。

sentences.en: (Laughter) And yeah, that's all. Two parachutes.
sentences.zh: 笑嗯，就这些了。两幅降落伞

sentences.en: That means, if I have a problem with the first one I pull, I still have the possibility to open the second one.
sentences.zh: 就是说，如果我拉的第一副降落伞出了问题我还可以打开第二个所以这是救命用的

sentences.en: And this is my life. That's the real important thing about safety.
sentences.zh: 所以这是救命用的这对于安全真的很重要我在过去的15年中

sentences.en: I did use that during these last 15 years about 20 times.
sentences.zh: 我在过去的15年中使用过大约20次--但是在开始飞的时候。有了这种翅膀后从没用过。

sentences.en: Never with that type of wing, but at the beginning.
sentences.zh: 但是在开始飞的时候。有了这种翅膀后从没用过。我在旋转时，不稳定时

sentences.en: I can release my wing when I am in a spin or unstable.
sentences.zh: 我在旋转时，不稳定时就可以打开翅膀。BG： 我们看到在2009年你穿越直布罗陀海峡时

sentences.en: BG: We saw the 2009 crossing of the Gibraltar Strait where you lost control and then you dived down into the clouds and in the ocean.
sentences.zh: BG： 我们看到在2009年你穿越直布罗陀海峡时失去了控制然后你俯冲到云里又冲到海里

sentences.en: So that was one of those cases where you let the wings go, right?
sentences.zh: 你就是在那种情况下你会放开翅膀的，是吗？YR： 是的。 我在云层里尝试

sentences.en: YR: Yeah. I did try in the clouds, but you lose orientation completely.
sentences.zh: YR： 是的。 我在云层里尝试但是完全失去了方向。

sentences.en: So I did try to take, again, a climb altitude.
sentences.zh: 所以我又尝试在往上飞。我想，没问题，我会出去的。

sentences.en: I thought, okay, I will go out. But most probably, I did something like that.
sentences.zh: 我想，没问题，我会出去的。但是，确实有可能，我那样做了。

sentences.en: (Laughter) BG: Something that is not very safe, the image.
sentences.zh: 但是，确实有可能，我那样做了。BG： 那样看起来可不安全啊。

sentences.en: YR: You feel great, but -- (Laughter) But you have not the right altitude.
sentences.zh: YR：但你感觉很棒只是高度不对。所以后来我看到的就是蓝色

sentences.en: So the next thing I saw was just blue. It was the sea.
sentences.zh: 所以后来我看到的就是蓝色是大海

sentences.en: I have also an audible altimeter. So I was at my minimum altitude in that vector -- fast -- so I pulled that.
sentences.zh: 我还有一只发声测高器所以我在那个航线的最低高度，速度很快拉降落伞然后就拉开了

sentences.en: And then I did open my chute. BG: So the wings have their own parachute, and you have your two parachutes.
sentences.zh: 然后就拉开了所以每个翅膀上都有一个降落伞，总共有两个。YR： 确实。翅膀上有一个救援降落伞

sentences.en: YR: Exactly. There is a rescue parachute for the wing for two reasons: so I can repair it afterward and especially so nobody takes that, just on his head.
sentences.zh: YR： 确实。翅膀上有一个救援降落伞主要有两个原因一来可以在事后修理另外主要是没有人会拿，就在头顶上。BG： 明白。也许回到这里来

sentences.en: BG: I see. Maybe come back here. This is risky stuff indeed.
sentences.zh: BG： 明白。也许回到这里来这确实是很危险的。有人尝试做这样的事结果送命了。

sentences.en: People have died trying to do this kind of thing.
sentences.zh: 有人尝试做这样的事结果送命了。你看起来不像疯狂的家伙，你是瑞士飞行员。

sentences.en: And you don't look like a crazy guy; you're a Swiss airline pilot, so you're rather a checklist kind of guy.
sentences.zh: 你看起来不像疯狂的家伙，你是瑞士飞行员。所以你是很仔细的人我估计你有你的标准。

sentences.en: I assume you have standards. YR: Yeah. I have no checklist for that.
sentences.zh: 我估计你有你的标准。是的。但我没有什么检查清单。BG： 不要告诉你的老板哦！

sentences.en: (Laughter) BG: Let's not tell your employer.
sentences.zh: BG： 不要告诉你的老板哦！

sentences.en: (Laughter) YR: No, that's really two worlds.
sentences.zh: YR：不，这是两个世界。

sentences.en: Civil aviation is something that we know very well.
sentences.zh: 我们很了解民航已有两百年的经验

sentences.en: We have a hundred years of experience. And you can adapt really precisely.
sentences.zh: 已有两百年的经验因此我们可以恪守规定

sentences.en: With that, I have to adapt to something new.
sentences.zh: 规定但是现在是全新的东西，需要去适应

sentences.en: That means improvise. So it's really a play between these two approaches.
sentences.zh: 这意味着改进所以这实在是这两套系统有一些我很熟悉

sentences.en: Something that I know very well, these principles.
sentences.zh: 有一些我很熟悉比如这些原则

sentences.en: For example, we have two engines on an Airbus; with only one engine, you can fly it.
sentences.zh: 比如这些原则一架空中客车有两个引擎但是我们只需要有一个就可以飞行了。所以要有第二套计划，总是要准备第二套计划。

sentences.en: So plan B, always a plan B. In a fighter, you have an ejection seat.
sentences.zh: 所以要有第二套计划，总是要准备第二套计划。在飞机上，有一个弹射座椅这是我的弹射座椅。

sentences.en: That's my ejection seat. So I have the approach of a professional pilot with the respect of a pioneer in front of Mother Nature.
sentences.zh: 这是我的弹射座椅。所以我有职业飞行员在自然母亲面前表示尊敬的做法

sentences.en: BG: It's well said. What happens if one of the engines stops?
sentences.zh: BG： 说的好，说的好。如果其中的一个引擎坏了怎么办

sentences.en: YR: I do a roll. And then I stabilize, and according to my altitude, I continue on two or three engines.
sentences.zh: YR: 我换另一个用。然后我根据我的高度稳定速度再用两到三个引擎。这是可能的--

sentences.en: It's sometimes possible. It's quite complicated to explain, but according to which regime I was, I can continue on two and try to get a nice place to land, and then I open my parachute.
sentences.zh: 这是可能的--要解释起来比较复杂但是我采取的方法是继续用第二个引擎找到安全的地方准备降落，然后打开降落伞。BG： 在飞行开始之时

sentences.en: BG: So the beginning of the flight is actually you jump off a plane or a helicopter, and you go on a dive and accelerate the engines, and then you basically take off mid-air somewhere.
sentences.zh: BG： 在飞行开始之时你实际上会从飞机或直升机上跳下继续俯冲，加速引擎然后在空中起飞

sentences.en: And then the landing, as we have seen, arriving on this side of the Channel, is through a parachute.
sentences.zh: 再降落，正如我们所见到的通过降落伞在海峡这边抵达有些好奇

sentences.en: So just as a curiosity, where did you land when you flew over the Grand Canyon?
sentences.zh: 有些好奇你在飞跃大峡谷时在哪里降落呢？是在边缘还是在底谷？

sentences.en: Did you land on the rim, down at the bottom?
sentences.zh: 是在边缘还是在底谷？

sentences.en: YR: It was down on the bottom. And I came back afterward on the sled of the helicopter back.
sentences.zh: YR: 是在底谷之后我乘坐在直升机后部的滑板上回来在上面岩石坚硬，而且长满仙人掌。

sentences.en: But it was too stony and full of cactus on top.
sentences.zh: 在上面岩石坚硬，而且长满仙人掌。BG： 所以我才要问这个问题。

sentences.en: (Laughter) BG: That's exactly why I asked the question.
sentences.zh: BG： 所以我才要问这个问题。而且那里的气流也很奇怪

sentences.en: YR: And also, the currents are quite funny there.
sentences.zh: 而且那里的气流也很奇怪有大的热流活动

sentences.en: There is big thermal activity, big difference in altitude also.
sentences.zh: 有大的热流活动海拔高度也有大的不同。所以降落在低谷安全的多。

sentences.en: So it was much safer for me to land at the bottom.
sentences.zh: 所以降落在低谷安全的多。BG： 现在，我想，很多在坐的观众

sentences.en: BG: I think that right now, many people are asking, "When are you developing a double-seater so they can fly with you?"
sentences.zh: BG： 现在，我想，很多在坐的观众一定想问：“ 好啊，什么时候你能设计双座他们可以和你一起飞？”

sentences.en: YR: I have a standard answer. Have you ever seen tandem birds?
sentences.zh: YR： 我有标准答案你有见过纵排飞行的鸟呢？

sentences.en: (Laughter) BG: Perfect answer. (Applause) (Applause ends) BG: Yves, one last question.
sentences.zh: BG： 太棒的答案！（掌声）Yves,最后一个问题下一步的计划是什么？飞人的下一步计划是什么？

sentences.en: What's next for you? What's next for Jetman?
sentences.zh: 下一步的计划是什么？飞人的下一步计划是什么？

sentences.en: YR: First, to instruct a younger guy. I want to share it, to do formation flights.
sentences.zh: YR：首先，带一个学徒我想分享我的飞行经验，进行常规飞行

sentences.en: And I plan to start from a cliff, like catapulted from a cliff.
sentences.zh: 进行常规飞行然后我计划从悬崖开始从悬崖上如弹射器般发射BG：就是不从飞机上跳下了，是吗？

sentences.en: BG: So instead of jumping off a plane, yes?
sentences.zh: BG：就是不从飞机上跳下了，是吗？YR： 是的，最终的目标是要起飞

sentences.en: YR: Yes, with the final goal to take off, but with initial speed.
sentences.zh: YR： 是的，最终的目标是要起飞但是初始速度是那样的。是的，我是按部就班的做

sentences.en: Really, I go step by step. It seems a little bit crazy, but it's not.
sentences.zh: 是的，我是按部就班的做看起来有点疯狂实际上并不是的。

sentences.en: It's possible to start already now, it's just too dangerous.
sentences.zh: 实际上并不是的。其实现在就可以开始了，就是还觉得太危险（笑）

sentences.en: (Laughter) Thanks to the increasing technology, better technology, it will be safe.
sentences.zh: （笑）由于不断完善的技术会安全的。我希望今后每个人都可以飞。

sentences.en: And I hope it will be for everybody. BG: Yves, thank you very much. Yves Rossy.
sentences.zh: 我希望今后每个人都可以飞。BG： Yves,非常谢谢， Yves Rossy.(鼓掌）

sentences.en: (Applause)
sentences.zh: (鼓掌）
